newsitem.title: UK: Welcome Break race led by Investcorp - paper.
newsitem.headline: Welcome Break race led by Investcorp - paper.

text.p: Arab-backed Investcorp is expected to emerge as the frontrunner to buy Granada Group Plc motorway service-stations chain Welcome Break this week, according to The Sunday Times newspaper.
The group is bidding as the financial backer of Michael Guthrie who sold his Pavilion motorway-services company to Granada in 1995.

The newspaper said that Investcorp has been selected as the preferred bidder in the auction and has offered between 400 and 450 million stg for Welcome Break, topping a 400 million stg bid from supermarket chain Asda Group.
If Investcorp succeeds in buying the business, it will work with Guthrie to expand and improve its operations before seeking either a stock market flotation or trade sale, the paper said.
